title: thanatome: Donor Death Signatures for Post-Mortem Control Tissue
description: R/Bioconductor package that annotates each sample of a post-mortem tissue cohort (GTEx or similar) with its position along two transcriptional axes of donor death derived from GTEx v8 across ten tissues (ventilator, perfused versus post-mortem; prolonged agony), plus the ischemia component of the ventilator axis, and helps select and audit control samples for differential expression.
notes: Funded by the Instituto Nacional de Medicina Genómica (ROR https://ror.org/01qjckx08), project INMEGEN-2026-14, Proyecto 81.
